#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    if (m > n) {
        swap(n, m);
    }

    if (m >= 3) {
        if ((m * n) % 2 == 1) {
            cout << m * n - 1 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << m * n << endl;
        }
    } else if (m == 2) {
        if (n == 2) {
            cout << 0 << endl;
        } else if (n == 3) {
            cout << 4 << endl;
        } else if (n == 7) {
            cout << 12 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << n * m << endl;
        }
    } else {
        int remainder = n % 6;
        int total = (n / 6) * 6;
        if (remainder == 5) {
            total += 4;
        } else if (remainder == 4) {
            total += 2;
        }
        cout << total << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
